correctness.rationale: The exact affine cusp image is recovered from first three coordinates for every d>=3 and odd characteristic. Its Fitt_2 differentials give k[u,y]/(y^3) in char3 and k[u,y]/(y^2) otherwise; reversed charts and smooth tangent-direction charts exclude additional components. Tangent normalization transition r=-s/(t(t+ds)) gives nilpotent graded line bundles O(-4j), and Euler-characteristic additivity establishes 3dn-9. Exact cubic specialization is checked independently by symbolic arithmetic; bounded verification is corroborative.
